dictionary.name: 脑袋加一：ECDICT 考试标签词库
dictionary.selection: All usable entries with corresponding source tags; no cap and no frequency/word-length exclusion. Preserve source headword case, short basic words, compounds, abbreviations and multiword entries. Missing phonetics are allowed. Chinese gloss is required. Manual exclusions are documented in exclusions.json. Geographic/calendar/cultural vocabulary is retained when tagged; capitalization alone does not imply an invalid entry. Source-tagged inflected forms remain separate entries.
dictionary.coverageNotice: 完整导入所用 ECDICT 数据版本中可用的考研（ky）、四级（cet4）、六级（cet6）及雅思（ielts）标签词条，无数量上限；这些第三方标签不等于官方完整考纲，雅思词集也不是官方词表。
dictionary.definitionNotice: Chinese glosses and phonetics are verbatim from the pinned CSV except literal newline expansion. Upstream errors and varied phonetic conventions may remain; no definitions or phonetics are generated.
dictionary.licenseNotice: Upstream repository declares MIT; preserve the license notice. This is not an independent audit of every historical contributing source. The separately restricted lemma.en.txt is not used.

phrases.name: 常用搭配精选
phrases.provenance: Phrase choices, Chinese explanations and bilingual example sentences authored for this app. Examples are original illustrative sentences, not quotations from a dictionary or examination.
phrases.coverageNotice: 仅 77 个精选词提供关联短语，不代表所有单词均有短语；短语并非官方考试词表。
phrases.relation: Tracks inherit complete parent-word membership from ECDICT tags; phrase wording/examples are existing authored app content, not source dictionary examples or official exam classifications.

verification.method: Fresh download of pinned upstream CSV; SHA-256 equality checked against previously pinned source. Upstream repository and license independently browsed.
